responsibility: Implements GCC’s core alias-analysis services used by both the middle end and RTL back end to decide whether memory references can overlap. It builds and queries type-based alias-set relationships, tracks component and pointer aliasing distinctions, compares tree and RTL memory references, and runs per-function base-value analysis for registers and MEMs so optimization and scheduling passes can disambiguate loads, stores, and clobbers. It also exposes statistics and supports special alias barriers such as universal-conflict memory sets.
same_name_distinction: Implements the alias-analysis machinery itself, including alias-set data structures, MEM/tree conflict logic, and per-function RTL base-value analysis; unlike gcc/alias.h, which only declares the public alias-query and alias-set API plus the memory-barrier constant.
